# Evaluate Interpolating Polynomial

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Evaluate the interval polynomial 2 + 3x on \[0,2\]. Coefficients are stored in increasing power. Its values at 0, 1 and 2 are 2, 5 and 8.

## What this example demonstrates
